blocks.text: A music festival in Saudi Arabia announced in an email to ticket holders Wednesday, Sept. 30, that it was being postponed, becoming the latest entertainment event to be nixed amid the ongoing Middle East war. Meanwhile, US rap star Kanye West’s two planned concerts in Russia have been canceled, organizers said also on Wednesday, less than two months after their surprise announcement triggered a frenzy of media attention and excitement among Russians.
